title: Vampire Vape Bubblegum 10ml E-Liquid
description: The Vampire Vape Bubblegum E-Liquid is an irresistibly fruity candy rush, with dominant strawberry and banana flavours woven into that nostalgic sweet, sugary and sunny candy Bubblegum flavour we all remember from our childhood. It’s a super smooth vaping experience that’s a great all day vape. Making Bubblegum by Vampire Vape the perfect addition to any sweet, toothed vapers collection. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please Note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage , sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
